verdict.rationale: Skyvern exposes a hosted REST API, with a published OpenAPI spec containing POST /v1/run/tasks, that runs a cloud browser on the caller's behalf from a prompt and URL and returns structured output. Results can be delivered by passing a webhook_url, which receives a single POST when the run reaches a terminal status. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented polling endpoint for fetching run status/results, and independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted API-plus-webhook flow.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can submit a browser task over a hosted HTTP API and receive the result by polling or webhook, without managing any browser myself

citations.quote: with run endpoints such as POST /v1/run/tasks
You send Skyvern a prompt and a URL, Skyvern runs a cloud browser, and you get structured output back.
Pass webhook_url when you start a run. Skyvern sends one POST to that URL when the run reaches a terminal status
